# Bell Italia

> > Bell Italia is a wholesale distributor of premium Italian wines, Prosecco, sparkling wines, and liqueurs featuring brands like Cantina Bolla, Bottega, Bella Tavola, and Borsci.

Bell Italia specializes in importing and distributing authentic Italian beverages, with a focus on Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG, traditional table wines, and artisan cream liqueurs. The company serves as a bridge between renowned Italian producers and wholesale markets.

## Key Topics

- Cantina Bolla
- Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG
- Italian wine wholesale
- Prosecco and sparkling wine
- Bottega cream liqueurs
- Bella Tavola table wines
- Borsci San Marzano liqueur
- Vino Spumante Extra Dry
- Grappa products
- Wine carafes
- Pistachio cream liqueur
- DOCG certification
- Italian spirits distribution

## Prosecco & Sparkling Wines

- [Cantina Bolla: Wholesale Prosecco and Sparkling Wine](https://www.bell-italia.com/en/bolla): Cantina Bolla wholesale Prosecco & sparkling wine from Valdobbiadene

## Italian Liqueurs & Spirits

- [Bottega](https://www.bell-italia.com/en/bottega): Bottega cream liqueurs: pistachio, chocolate & grappa products
- [Borsci](https://www.bell-italia.com/en/borsci): Borsci San Marzano Italian liqueur and spirits

## Table Wines

- [Bella Tavola](https://www.bell-italia.com/en/bella-tavola): Bella Tavola Italian table wines in carafes (red & white)
